notes.title: Towertale version 1.2 (Co-op update) is now live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/b50416c0eb37ecab90f679937bcf0b4133ec8e49.gif[/img]

Greetings and salutations everyone!

It's been 9 long months since we initially released Towertale on steam. The game has changed a lot since the initial release. The most notable change is that we added a new Co-op feature that lets you play with your friends up to 4 players!

[h1]New Co-op Content:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/4ccd7c86ace460082d5cef6bd6e587846543a7ca.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/95f5985f2f5fff3fb66c60db0ac4757f6559b68c.png[/img]

You can now team up with your friends on all game modes, Story, Arcade, Free and Boss Rush.

[h3]A new storyline and ending.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/34d8cd79ee180083f5246e3abb0995539d1e20fc.png[/img]

We added a new storyline for the Co-op mode. It can be played by yourself or with friends.

[h3]Remote Play Together[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/9b43ea875ef47f6e39f7857583eb8bdab7b8da04.png[/img]

The game is compatible with Steam's Remote Play Together feature. Which means, you can play co-op with your friends online! Though, it is recommended to have at least 30mbps of Upload/Download speed for it to be playable. If not, try setting the the host's limit resolution to 480p and the client's options to fast. If you want to learn more about Remote Play Together, you can [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]click here[/url].


[h1]New Features:[/h1]
[h3]Scenario Selector[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/fcc0b78b158db0a41944b8e11c4fbd52b1a49a0e.png[/img]

After implementing the Skip function last patch, our next step was adding the Scenario Selector. You can now play/replay any parts of the game so long as you unlocked that scenario!

[h3]The Gallery[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/c155f0611a1dfda632d3d37c0c0b550615e41569.png[/img]

Another thing we wanted to add was the gallery. There are a lot of great Art from the story mode, we wanted a place to collect them and let the player view them at any time.

[h3]A new main menu art and music[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/da9ecd16954777b1270b12398cc90cfb516e6a2b.png[/img]

With these all new features added, we couldn't resist to put a new main menu art and music to the game.

[h3]Filipino and Dutch Localization[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/923fd06f5a74a8e2282ecf3e0ecab34c04a8c60c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/6a57c0e4d2a4d143289fac7182886bd58a74b326.png[/img]

The game now supports Filipino and Dutch translations. Currently, portugese and Czech language are being worked on by our discord members. More will come hopefully in the future. 

If you want to help out with localizations, please join our discord server:
https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

[h1]Nintendo Switch Release[/h1]

It's been a long time coming but we finally got a switch release! After we released on steam, we couldn't meet our sales goal. We wanted the game to be played by a larger amount of players and we believe Nintendo Switch was a good fit for the game. Hopefully the sales will be enough to carry us over the initial stages of our next project. As, up till now, we still haven't paid up our debts.

All of these updates are actually part of the things we added to the Nintendo Switch. But I told my publisher that I didn't want our steam customers to feel left out so we opted to bring the free update to steam too. 

You can watch the switch release trailer here:
https://youtu.be/aDaRXgxMPwk

[h2]Price change[/h2]

With all of these changes that we made, we feel that Towertale as a product is finally complete. It was discussed with my console publisher that we would raise the price of the game to $9.99. Hopefully that will mean that everyone who bought the game before this update will feel that the game has raised its value. Just putting this out there for transparency.


[h2]Final words[/h2]

Lastly, I'd like to say thank you to everyone who played the game. This was our first commercial release and we really learned a lot from it. And I promise you that our next game is going to be really better since everyone in the team has leveled up their skills. We hope to bring you more awesome games in the future!

notes.title: Towertale updated to v1.1.5 + Free Co-op Patch Announcement!
notes.content:
Greetings all! Hope you are all well.

We are back, and we just patched Towertale to version 1.1.5! Just in time for Steam Autumn Sale! Below are some minor changes / bug fixes / improvements as well as the long requested [b]Skip Feature[/b] for the story mode. 

We will also would like to announce that the [b]free Co-op patch[/b] and Switch release will finally be live on[b] [strike]January 2020[/strike] Delayed to Q1 due to the switch build note being ready yet.[/b]

[h1]Reworked UI, Optimizations, & Bug fixes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34016941/4d9929f4011cd7de4f96838cc64856f5564e5eaf.gif[/img]

Changelog version 1.1.5:

- Added Skip Feature for all dialogues in Story Mode
- Snicklefritz targeting now requires him to face the enemy for tier 3 magics
- Fixed a couple of snicklefritz bugs
- Optimized load times between scenes
- Removed old Main Menu Buttons
- Reworked Main Menu Buttons UI
- Fixed FPS not displaying the correct FPS
- Fixed some bugs that are preventing progression in Story Mode
- Fixed some audio / SFX inconsistencies
- Fixed Pausing on Sandworm provides huge drop in FPS
- Reworked buttons UI to adjust to the correct binded controls
- Added Buttons to Interactable entities
- Fixed controller vibrations sometimes not responding
- Fixed achievements in offline mode
- Prepared the game for Co-op
- Fixed "Available in Full game" appearing on Boss-rush mode
- Made boss-rush mode already unlocked instead of being unlockable
- Removed being able to restart on arcade and boss rush modes
- Increased bosses Hps when you are with CPU allies
- Buffed Goblin and Darkest Echo attack speeds
- Fixed some UI issues on main menu

[h1]Free Co-op Patch and Nintendo Switch Release Coming this [b] [strike]January 2020[/strike] Delayed to Q1 due to the switch build note being ready yet.[/b][/h1]

We've been working hard these past months to bring Towertale to nintendo switch. We are focusing more on the co-op features in the game. The new co-op mode will support up to 4 players and will be available to play online with steam's new [b]Remote Play Together[/b] feature. We are adding a few new features: CG Gallery, Scenario Selector for story mode and an alternate ending for the Co-op's story mode.

We also might do a beta test for the co-op before we release it. 

If you are interested in joining the Co-op beta test, please join our discord server:
https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

Expect all new co-op features this [b] [strike]January 2020[/strike] Delayed to Q1 2020 due to the switch build note being ready yet.[/b]

Also, Towertale is also currently on a [b]25% discount[/b] this Autumn sale 2019 from November 6 to December 3. You can also get up to 40% if you buy the Game + Soundtrack Bundle!

Thank you all and we hope you have a nice day! :)

notes.title: Coming to Switch announcement! Co-op mode coming to steam version too!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/eeccdb92e15613942df30239a096364f20876de3.png[/img]

[h1]Towertale is coming to the Nintendo Switch![/h1]

Hello guys! We're really excited to announce that Towertale is coming to the Nintendo Switch! It's been a while since our intial steam release. We have been searching for a publisher who want to help us get the game on consoles. We're glad to say that we will be working with [url=https://www.keybolgames.com/] Keybol Games[/url]. They will help us get the game on Switch, PS4 and XBOX ONE! But we are doing the releases one at a time. The Switch version will come first!

[h1]Couch co-op is coming to the steam version too![/h1]

A feature that is highly requested by some folks is the Co-op! We are going to work on it along with the switch release. But we don't want our steam customers to feel left out so the coop will also be available on the steam version too!

[h1]What happened to the localization and mac build?[/h1]

The localization system is going to be worked on after we have successfully ported the game on the switch. We too want to release other languages when we make our console release. As for the mac build, keybol is going to help us test it out so expect it to come out eventually!

[h1]Other future plans, our next game?[/h1]

As for our future plans. A mobile release is also being made alongside the switch port. But the switch port will take priority first. 

We are also already planning for our next game. We might take a break from making a big project such as Towertale. We need to scale down because we still haven't have enough sales sold on steam yet sadly. But we promise to bring another quality game the next time around too!

Thank you all for reading!

notes.title: Towertale Updated to version 1.1.3 + Some updates.
notes.content:
Greetings all! Here are some minor fixes and adjustments requested by some users. Will also talk a bit about localization and the mac build.

[h1]Changelog v1.1.3:[/h1]
- Added 3 continues to Arcade Mode.
- Fixed: Goblin trident powerup sound not adjusting to audio settings.
- Fixed: Eternal Watcher Ognimus Laser charging sound not adjusting to audio settings.
- Adjusted: Creator BG elements being broken.
- Increased size of projectile markers.
- Switch back proper text to old boss-rush mode text rather than the demo text.

[h1]Changelog v1.1.2:[/h1]
- Fixed Achievements not showing in the achievements screen.

[h1]Changelog v1.1.1:[/h1]
- Added copy to empty save slot


[h1]Mac Build update:[/h1]

We're sorry to say that we are going to delay the mac build for now. Mainly because we don't have a mac device that we can test on. Some friends help out testing the game but there seems to be a problem stopping the progression in the mac build. We will be sure to do the mac port once we are able to buy a device. Sorry for the inconvenience.

[h1]Localization update:[/h1]

We are going to work on the localization system this week. Hopefully after that we are able to add more language support for the game. Though we haven't sold enough copies for us to get all languages. We might acquire them as we sell more copies in the future.

We are considering crowdsourcing the localization. If you want to help out and maybe get some perks for our next games, feel free to reach out. 

The best way to contact us is by joining our discord server:
https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

Thank you all and have a nice day!

notes.title: Towertale final build complete! Game releases on July 30!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/150f3616cda0fcc66ca620def08a90148325e8e8.png[/img]

[h1]Sorry for the delay![/h1]

Hello all! It's been a while. First of all, we would like to say sorry for not being able to meet our July 9, planned release date. Some personal life things have happened during the last two weeks of June. Like Soulty had to move out of her parents house and we had to move our stuff around. That ate up our precious development time. We were confident before on hitting the deadline but I guess there's nothing you can do when these things happen. We are very sorry and we promise that we will learn from this experience.

[h1]The game is complete![/h1]

On a good note, we are happy to announce that the final build for Towertale is finally complete! It's been a long two years but we are very excited to let people play the full game. Based on the feedback from the demo and people from the internal team testing the game, we are expecting the full game to be 6-20 hours long depending on how fast you read all the dialogue and how swiftly you beat the bosses.

[h1]So when is the game going to be released?[/h1]

Since we just finished the full game, we may need a bit of time to do some quality assurance to clean up the remaining known bugs. We are a small team of 5 but everyone is helping out on internally testing the game. Also shouting out to the people from our discord server and team Akio for pointing out some game breaking bugs that was missed by the internal team. Anyway, if you haven't already, please join our discord server, I will put the link below.

Our final release date is going to be on the [b]30th of july[/b]!

Hopefully this will give us the necessary time to do some last minute polish and bug fixing so we can have a smooth release.

We will also use this time to send out review copies of the game out to influencers and gaming websites so the game will have a bit of traffic on release!

If you are a streamer/youtuber/gaming site and want to cover our game, we are now accepting press key requests from Keymailer:

https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/72904

We will send the keys by june 15 or 16.

[h1]Towertale Soundtrack DLC Release![/h1]

Alongside the full release of the game, we will also release the Towertale Original Soundtrack as DLC. 

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/88788cf536601c5d8a6eb3de10ee0c4daa6239f6.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/79c6c32c6d3155db326689a7b974d5875163c5a9.jpg[/img][/url] [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/58d9a3fa48f37b2827998cc0b029c352c1658c2d.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/57d7f3e3fa22c0a6b595734f155d397a454e8d25.jpg[/img][/url]

The composers, Gina and Mordi did a spectacular job with the soundtrack. With them the game was brought to life. The proceeds from the Soundtrack DLC will go to them so if you'd like to support them, please buy it!

You can listen to the main theme of Towertale here:
https://soundcloud.com/mordi-1/towertale

You can also check Mordi and Gina's soundcloud channels. They have already released some of the tracks there:

https://soundcloud.com/mordi-1
https://soundcloud.com/ginaloughlin

Overall the total time for the music in game is over 50 minutes!

[h1]Last notes and pricing for the game[/h1]

We've decided that the final price for the game will be [b]7.99 USD[/b]. This is our first title so we want to make the price to be more affordable to gamers as much as possible.  The soundtrack DLC will be priced at [b]4.99 USD[/b] and buying the Soundtrack + Game bundle will only be [b]10 USD[/b]!

Lastly, we would like to thank everyone who tried out our demo! We have gathered a lot of feedback and we've started to grow our community on discord because of that. Special thanks to those who created let's play videos of the demo even though we haven't reached out to people yet. Lots of thanks to everyone who was interested in the game! We hope you will like the full release!

If you wanna get updated with the game please join us on discord:

https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

Thank you! Have a nice day!

notes.title: Demo Updated to v1.2 - 1.3 Bug fixes and a few changes
notes.content:
Keeping this short and simple.

We have received a lot of feedback from players who played our demo. We did a lot of bug fixes which can be seen below. If you are playing an earlier version of the demo, please download the latest one (v1.3).

Demo v 1.3 Fixes:

- Added Controls Panel that displays the controls for that character + details. Accessible through Tab or Right stick button.
- Fixed Battle Pause Menu not navigating to Main Menu Button
- Fixed Lionel Issue where his dash + attack could stop the player from moving.
Lionel and Dark Echo Not having tutorial menus on story mode.

Demo v 1.2.5 Fixes:

- Changed Minotaur hitboxes to prevent cheesing.
- Fixed unable to skip Intro after skipping once.
-  Changed Tutorial to appear after intro + backstory scenes rather than Tutorial first.
- Changed flavor text for difficulty selection.
- Changed a few dialogues on snicklefritz intro (Tower Entrance Scene)
- Fixed Crashing on tutorial issue on v1.2
- Buffed Minotaur Charge. You can now get hit behind him when he's charging.
- Increased Lionel's projectile mana cost.
- Added more effects to minotaur smash attacks

Demo v 1.2 Fixes:

- Fain flipping backwards with attack + different direction + dodge.
- Able to do actions at the start of battle in story mode.(still able to do 1 frame of attack if spammed)
- No SFX played on load menu
- Semi Fixed UI crashing on pausing the game after retrying battle.
- Removed changing camera after tier 3 casting (fritz) - This ultimately fixes the camera lockon issue on tower entrance scene.
- Changed Slime King's movement mechanics.
- Changed how slow works, removed animation debuff added more slow. Cannot dash or use secondary when slow/impaired.
- Added "Impaired" and "Stamina++" text indicators.

- Snicklefritz's crouch now disables charging. (fixes crash hanging issue)
- Snicklefritz known visual bugs.
- Fixed Fritz Charing on no stamina instantly charges to tier 3(visually)
- Fixed UI issues(level select, main menu and character select)

Removed minotaur cheese strat

Buffed Slime King


If you find any more bugs, please report it in our discord server:
https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

notes.title: Release date Trailer + Playable Demo Released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34016941/7e70bef61d9cb1dc69246b0dfab754310a6a19fe.png[/img]

[h1]We are proud to announce that Towertale will have it's full release on July 10th, 2019! Demo is now available to play![/h1]

Greetings and salutations! It's been two years since we started development on Towertale. It has been a long and painful journey but we are excited that we finally get a glimpse of the end! 

[h1]Release Date[/h1]

The full game will be released on July 10, 2019! Although no date has been included in the trailer, we are playing it safe because this is our first game. we don't know if there are problems that are going to occur like if steam will take time to review our game and the release get's delayed(hopefully not).

[h1]Game at it's final stages[/h1]
As for the progress. All that's left to do in the game are encoding the final chapter, implementing the arcade and boss rush modes and adding steam Achievements + Trading cards.

For the music, our composers did a splendid job on bringing the game to life. We are expecting a total of 34 unique tracks, spanning up to 50+ minutes! All are to be used on character themes, boss themes and story themes.

Here are some sample tracks you can listen to:

"Dark Echo"'s theme by Gina Loughlin:
https://soundcloud.com/ginaloughlin/dark-echos-theme

Slime King's battle theme by Mordi:
https://soundcloud.com/mordi-1/towertale-boss-battle-slime-king


[h1]New Trailer[/h1]

As you probably may have seen, we have uploaded a new trailer to the store page. If you haven't watched it yet, be sure to take a look at it! It is a more complete trailer than our previous one. It now shows snippets of character story, game play as well as a few teasers on what the full game may have to offer.

[h1]Playable Demo[/h1]

Another thing we have been eagerly to release is the demo of the game. It was actually already finished around the third week of may but we had to do some QA rounds in order to squash those unwanted bugs. We also wanted to wait for a definitive final release date before we release it. Doing so gave us more time to make certain adjustments and extra polish for the game.


[h1]Localization Plans[/h1]

After finishing the game, we might look into localizing it to certain popular languages such as Chinese, French, Japanese, German, Portuguese and Russian. Though these update might happen post release.


[h1]Final thoughts from the Developers[/h1]

So that concludes our update! We hope you try out the demo and consider wishlisting / buying the game on launch. We are currently an unknown team as of now and this will be our very first game. But I want you to all know that we are very passionate and are giving our best to make the best product we can produce with the capabilities we have now. We still have a lot of room for improvement but hopefully after releasing this, we may have our opportunity to grow more as developers.

Lastly, we just opened our discord server. If you want to hang out or ask us anything come say hi. :D

https://discord.gg/sqTmHvk

Thank you and have a nice day!
